description.value: Dozo House is a Japanese restaurant in Kelowna's north end serving fresh sushi, ramen, teppanyaki, donburi, and bento boxes made with premium ingredients. The name 'Dozo'—meaning 'please' in Japanese—reflects the welcoming, relaxed atmosphere the restaurant cultivates. Online ordering is available, and the extensive menu with gluten-free and vegetarian options makes it a versatile refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from dozohouse.ca, confirming an active Japanese restaurant at 200-1970 Kane Rd, Kelowna with a phone number (778-484-3883) and an 'Order Now' button indicating takeout. The menu prominently labels many items as G.F (gluten-free) and lists multiple vegetarian dishes (Vege Ramen, Vegetable Gyoza, Tofu Donburi, Vegetable Tempura). No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Dozo House Sushi' differs from the website branding, which uses 'DOZO House' and 'DOZO Japanese Restaurant' — the word 'Sushi' in the OSM name does not appear as part of the official business name on the website.
Phone number (778-484-3883) is absent from OSM but confirmed via website; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as OSM had no value to corroborate.

Website contains apparent hour-format typos (front page: '11:30am-2:30am'; contact page: '11:30pm-2:30pm') suggesting the site has not been carefully proofread, though the restaurant appears to be open and operating normally.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Japanese restaurant with a broad menu, GF and vegetarian options, and takeout availability; a solid Food & Drink directory entry for touring cyclists in Kelowna.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks numerous items as G.F (gluten-free); vegetarian options include Vege Ramen, Vegetable Gyoza, Tofu Donburi, Vegetable Spring Rolls, and Vegetable Tempura
